title: Evaluation of a two-input disjunction gate
statement: For any natural numbers $a,b$ and any Boolean value list $v$, the value of a disjunction gate reading positions $a$ and $b$ is $v_a\lor v_b$, where an out-of-range list position is interpreted as false.
